summary: Server component (one instance): the inventory interaction requests after stack processing (esv::inventory::StackSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests fills it from InteractionRequestsWithGroupComponent; esv::inventory::InteractionSystem consumes it). Seen once in an idle level, empty. Third step of the chain InteractionRequests -> WithGroup -> WithStack.

fields.name: Inventory
fields.evidence: StackSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests (EoCServer.dll+0xF4BBA0) appends 16-byte copies of WithGroup's ContainerInteractionRequestData to +0 (assert IndexedStorage<esv::inventory::ContainerInteractionRequestData>). Same as SE ContainerInteractionRequestData.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: First qword of esv::inventory::MemberInteractionWithStackRequestData (macOS name of the element). Not destroyed (trivial); EntityHandle by analogy with MemberInteractionRequestData::Inventory, not confirmed.

fields.name: ActionData
fields.evidence: std::variant storage, 200 bytes: bg3.exe FUN_1422e2bd0 (stride 0xD8) destroys element+8 with FUN_1422d5900 when the index is 3 and FUN_1422d5960 when it is 5.

fields.name: ActionType
fields.evidence: Variant index at element+8+200 = +0xD0 (FUN_1422e2bd0 reads pFVar3[200]).

fields.name: Container
fields.evidence: StackSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests appends 16-byte copies to +0x20 with assert IndexedStorage<esv::inventory::NotifyInteractionRequestData>. SE NotifyInteractionRequestData.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: bg3.exe FUN_140fce290 destroys each 0x20-byte value as two DynamicArrays with trivial elements (FUN_1405bd630 clear + free at +0 and +0x10). Element type unknown - uint64_t is a placeholder.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Second DynamicArray of the value (see field_0). Element type unknown.

fields.name: ContainerInteractions
fields.evidence: bg3.exe creator 0x34B3230 (0x70 bytes): arrays at +0,+0x10,+0x20 and a HashMap at +0x30. Destructor FUN_1422cfdc0 clears +0 with the trivial-array clear. StackSystem::ProcessInventoryRequests (param_2 = this component) pushes ContainerInteractionRequestData (stride 0x10) to +0.

fields.name: MemberInteractions
fields.evidence: Destructor clears +0x10 with FUN_1422e2bd0 (stride 0xD8, variant element). macOS: DynamicArray<esv::inventory::MemberInteractionWithStackRequestData>; InteractionSystem::RemoveBrokenInventoryMembersFromInventories takes such an array.

fields.name: field_30
fields.evidence: Destructor: FUN_140fce290(+0x30) destroys the values at +0x60 (stride 0x20), frees them, then FUN_140582ad0(+0x30) frees the key set. Key assumed 8-byte EntityHandle (macOS StackSystem has HashMap<EntityHandle, StackSystem::EntityRequest>); not confirmed.

open_questions: Key type and value element types of the HashMap at +0x30.
Members of MemberInteractionWithStackRequestData beyond the variant.
status_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
second_pass: Not settled: key/value types of the HashMap at +0x30 and the head of the 0xD8 element were not traced in bg3.exe in this pass.
